The *Aṭṭhakapuggalapaññatti* is a section of the *Puggalapaññatti* ("Designation of Human Types"), the fourth book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Following the numerical matrix of the *mātīkā*, this chapter categorizes and defines individuals grouped into sets of eight [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations of the text in two modern languages [SuttaCentral].
